assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production modular sprite atlas for a richly layered 2D side-view dark fantasy exploration game. Painterly detailed materials, realistic worn texture, carefully readable silhouettes, restrained desaturated palette, cool indirect light. Strict orthographic side elevation, no isometric perspective. Genuinely transparent RGBA background. Landscape sheet with EXACTLY SIX separate complete cutouts in a regular 3-column by 2-row grid; each cutout stays entirely within its cell with at least 20 pixels transparent gutter all around, no overlapping cells. No labels, letters, numbers, borders, background landscape, UI, characters or watermark. Every cutout has a different asymmetrical silhouette; no copies. Soft contact shading only inside the object; no floating drop shadows. Six low wide ground-decoration clusters, each about 3 to 4 times wider than tall, all resting on a single horizontal baseline, no bulky island of terrain underneath. The clusters should combine several small materials into natural arrangements and taper into a few scattered pebbles/blades at both ends, so they can be layered along a path. Beautiful fine-grained detail that reads when a patch is about twice a character's width and no more than knee height. Row-major: 1 dense moss and small curled ferns among wet slate; 2 tangled fine roots around smooth aqueduct pebbles and tiny pale blue flowers; 3 scattered damp stones and reedlike cave grass; 4 several overlapping small shelf mushrooms and fallen twigs; 5 low worn masonry fragments partly swallowed by creeping ivy; 6 a wide dark foreground grass-and-fern fringe. Slate blue grey, moss olive, subtle pale turquoise accents.
